name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohung Plafing
beschreibung: The Bauernhof-Ferienwohnung Plafing is located in Ebbs, Tirol, and is part of a working farm. The accommodation offers several holiday apartments of different sizes for guests. Its location in the Naturregion Kaisergebirge provides direct access to hiking and cycling trails. From the farm, guests can take excursions to Burg Kufstein or the nearby wildlife park. The apartments are modernly furnished and have terraces or balconies. Regional products from the farm's own production are offered to guests. The quiet surroundings are ideal for those seeking relaxation.
